parts.html: The K-04 standard model is a contemporary L-shaped kitchen in a refined gray that combines clean-lined design, natural stone, and well-considered functionality. Solid-color painted fronts, the strict geometry of the cabinets, and a quartzite countertop create an understated, elegant interior.

The gray color palette makes the kitchen a versatile choice for modern apartments and private homes. It pairs beautifully with natural wood, stone textures, light walls, and decorative elements in dark tones.

The L-shaped layout makes efficient use of the work surface and storage systems while leaving comfortable room to move around. With no island, this model suits rooms where every square meter needs to be used wisely.

In the K-04 kitchen, special attention is given to the combination of materials. The upper and lower fronts are painted, the carcass is made of 18 mm laminated chipboard, and the quartzite countertop emphasizes the natural beauty of stone.

A cargo pull-out provides convenient storage. Hettich hinges with soft-close mechanisms ensure the doors close smoothly, while AvanTech YOU Hettich drawers complete the kitchen’s functional equipment.
DUMSKAYA DESIGN makes modern custom kitchens for apartments, condos, and private homes in Bratislava and Vienna.
The K-04 standard model can be adapted to the dimensions of a specific room, taking into account the location of utility lines and built-in appliances, as well as individual storage requirements.

We offer kitchen furniture design, material selection, manufacturing, delivery, and professional installation. At the client’s request, the kitchen can also be fitted with a sink, appliances, a range hood, and plumbing fixtures.
To order the K-04 kitchen or get a personalized price quote, contact DUMSKAYA DESIGN.
